message.content: The 2020 film that most critics and audiences crowned as the standout of the year was **“Parasite”**. Directed by Bong Joon‑ho, it won the Academy Award for Best Picture (for the 2019 awards cycle) and was praised for its sharp social commentary, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction. If you’re looking for a film that captured the imagination of both critics and the public in 2020, “Parasite” is the one to watch.
